name.ja: 1/35 U.C.HARD GRAPH ジオン公国軍 ランバ・ラル独立遊撃隊セット
name.en: 1/35 U.C.HARD GRAPH Zeon Principality Army Ramba Ral Independent Guerrilla Group Set

ja: U.C.ハードグラフ第２弾はホワイトベースに迫るランバ・ラル隊が登場。ランバ・ラル、ハモンを含む1/35スケールフィギュア6体と同スケールのザクヘッドが付属。フィギュアは全て、服装から表情まで微細に再現されたマルチカラードフィギュア。ザクヘッドには鋳造品を意識させるモールドを再現、内部にはモノアイなどのメカも精密に再現。細部表現用に水転写デカールが付属。
※組立てには接着剤などが必要になります。
en: The second edition of U.C. Hard Graph features the Ramba Ral squad approaching the White Base. Includes 6 1/35 scale figures including Ramba Ral and Hamon, and a Zaku head of the same scale. All figures are multi-colored figures that have been minutely reproduced from their clothes to their facial expressions. The Zaku head has a mold that makes you think of a cast product, and inside the machine, such as the mono-eye, is precisely reproduced. Water slide decals are included to express details.
